head: eeb7d4f8

findings.quote: 'Submitting the phone number and the code exchanges them for a session, and a wrong, expired, or replayed code is refused.',
findings.summary: otp-verify states no bound on verify attempts; reference verifyOtp has no counter; conformance tries one wrong code. A provider can be fully conformant and brute-forceable.
findings.failure_scenario: 10^6 guesses within the 5-minute TTL against one pending code.

findings.summary: Constant message claims no oracle, but PhoneIdentityError.refusal distinguishes expired-code from invalid-code and the port never requires collapsing it at the API boundary.
findings.failure_scenario: Sweep phone numbers with a dummy code; expired-code reveals registered/active numbers.

findings.summary: Lost-handset case named by whyItGates cannot be served: revoke is keyed by the access token only; no revoke-by-subject.
findings.failure_scenario: Stolen device's session lives to expiry.

findings.quote: 'GoTrue sign-out revokes the refresh token server-side; the access JWT remains valid until exp, which is bounded by the configured access-token lifetime.',
findings.summary: Supabase scored session-revoke 'yes' and Netlify 'partial' for the identical limit; journeyVerdict hides the shipping exposure.
findings.failure_scenario: Decision record undercounts a real exposure.

findings.summary: Residue test covers the COMMIT path only, not release without COMMIT/ROLLBACK.
findings.failure_scenario: A regression releasing a client mid-transaction goes undetected.

findings.quote: // ...and no SMS was sent to obtain it. If a send had happened the
findings.summary: Comment claims refresh sends no SMS; the assertion never inspects the sent-codes sink.
findings.failure_scenario: A refresh that triggers a send passes.

findings.quote: * imports this module outside the test tree, and the conformance test asserts
findings.summary: Header claims a conformance assertion that no non-test code imports this module; no such assertion exists.
findings.failure_scenario: A demo script imports the no-auth reference provider and nothing fails.

test_command: npm ci && npm test (Docker postgres:17-alpine for test:postgres); targeted: npx vitest run --config vitest.config.ts test/tenancy-isolation.integration.test.ts | test/phone-identity-conformance.test.ts; probe optional (network)
